premises: High configurational entropy stabilizes a homogeneous single-phase solid solution and suppresses phase separation.
Increasing configurational disorder improves catalytic activity and long-term stability for oxidation reactions.
High-entropy oxides can be synthesized as homogeneous, single-phase materials with uniform elemental distribution.
Enhanced metal–support interactions and oxygen vacancies in HEOs prevent PGM sintering and improve oxygen activation.
